items.title: Return completed claim form with game-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: Letter date (the triggering event) is Sat 21.11.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts Sun 22.11.2026. The letter defines 'Werktage' itself as Monday to Saturday excluding statutory public holidays (so Sundays are skipped, Saturdays count). Counting 13 such working days from 22.11.2026: 23.11(Mon,1), 24.11(Tue,2), 25.11(Wed,3), 26.11(Thu,4), 27.11(Fri,5), 28.11(Sat,6), [29.11 Sun skipped], 30.11(Mon,7), 01.12(Tue,8), 02.12(Wed,9), 03.12(Thu,10), 04.12(Fri,11), 05.12(Sat,12), [06.12 Sun skipped], 07.12(Mon,13). No public holiday falls in this window in Hessen (sender's seat) or NRW. The 13th working day is Monday 07.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: This is a private insurer's own contractual deadline (no statutory deemed-delivery or formal Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung rules apply); missing the date risks delay or reduction of the comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim rather than a legal remedy deadline.
The required enclosure is a Wildschadenbescheinigung from the Jagdpächter or the police plus the enclosed Schadenfragebogen — make sure both are obtained and enclosed before sending.

The payee IBAN printed in the footer (DE37 3705 0198 0005 5474 70) is a well-formed German IBAN matching the insurer's stated bank, but no payment is requested in this letter, so there is no payment instruction to verify here.
